classification: Additive ContextAttestation v2 linking signed token-security capture evidence to the exact normalized advisory view
receiptImpact: OracleSafetyCheck and ExecutionReceipt signed layouts, registry release, attester keys, partner policies, and activation set remain unchanged. ContextAttestation v2 adds a separately versioned typed-data signature over both the source-response digest and the exact normalized token-security view digest. The offline verifier links the supplied view to that signature; V1 remains verifiable as legacy evidence without a linked view. The raw source body is not returned or replayed, so this proves what Insight signed and returned, not that the upstream source was correct or that an agent consumed the data.
activationRule: This additive promotion exposes optional signed advisory token-security evidence on the existing pre-trade response and in the standalone offline verifier. It does not change a pre-trade verdict, grant trading authority, amend any partner policy or activation, or authorize partner reliance or automated execution. Missing fetch or signing evidence remains omitted. Production deployment stays behind the protected-main validate and smoke gates. This record does not publish an npm package or establish upstream source truth.
